name: validate-inputs-and-select-phase
description: Validate required inputs (origin, destination, departure_date, passengers) and that origin/destination are 3-letter IATA airport codes. If anything is missing or invalid, return message + status no_flights and stop. Otherwise determine phase: 'book' when flight_number is present, else 'search'.

name: search-and-present-options
description: SEARCH PHASE only (phase == 'search'): delegate the flight search to the flight-search-agent (agent____flight-search-agent) with origin, destination, travel_date (and passenger count); do NOT call a flight-search tool directly and do NOT book. Render the returned flights into the flights field and set status options_presented; if none returned, set status no_flights with a helpful message suggesting other dates or airport codes. Never invent flights, fares, or availability.

name: book-flight-and-pay
description: BOOK PHASE only (phase == 'book'): validate flight_number, departure_date, and passengers (at least one adult); call mcp-demo____bookTicket then mcp-demo____generatePaymentLink; compose output with message, status (booked/paid), pnr, flight_number, origin, destination, departure, passenger_count, amount_due, payment_link. Never invent PNRs, fares, or payment links.
output_template: {"message": "<summary for passenger>", "status": "options_presented | no_flights | booked | paid", "flights": "<flight options when searching>", "pnr": "<booking PNR>", "flight_number": "<booked flight>", "origin": "<IATA>", "destination": "<IATA>", "departure": "<date/time>", "passenger_count": 0, "amount_due": 0, "payment_link": "<url>"}
